description: Comprehensive edge-case verification covering hardwired x0 zero semantics, immediate range boundaries (+2047, -2048), two's complement overflow and underflow wrapping, unaligned memory access safety, and AUIPC PC-relative addressing.
features_tested: Hardwired x0 discard on register write
x0 evaluation to zero on register read
Sign extension of maximum positive immediate (+2047)
Sign extension of maximum negative immediate (-2048)
Unaligned memory store ignored without corrupting memory
Unaligned memory load returns zero safely
AUIPC computes current PC plus upper immediate
